info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Model By Param1-spec
info.description: The Customer Behavior Model Update API facilitates the modification of existing customer behavior models within the banking network. Utilizing this endpoint, authorized users can update specific parameters of a model identified by 'param1'. Typical consumers of this API include data analysts and bank operation teams looking to refine predictive models based on evolving customer data. This operation enables businesses to enhance their insights into customer behavior by ensuring models remain relevant and accurately reflect current trends.

patch.description: This operation allows for the modification of the Customer Behavior Model with ID CUST-100045. Use this endpoint to update specific attributes of the model based on your operational needs.
